# Copilot Instructions for searoute

## 1. Project Context
- This repository is a React 19 + TypeScript (strict) web app built with Vite for ferry route exploration in Japan, organized as a clean architecture.
- Keep deployment constraints in mind: static hosting (Cloudflare Pages via `.cloudflare/build.sh`, which publishes the Vite build as `deploy/`), PWA support, and browser-first runtime.
- Prioritize behavior stability for existing user flows (map view, route list, route filters, share URL restore).

## 2. Architecture Rules
- Preserve the existing layer boundaries:
  - `src/domain`: pure domain logic and types
  - `src/config`: static layer/style configuration (pure data)
  - `src/application`: use cases, ViewModels and port interfaces (no DOM / MapLibre / React)
  - `src/adapters`: port implementations for external systems (MapLibre, PMTiles, cookie, HTTP, geocoding, analytics)
  - `src/presentation`: React components and hooks (`common/`, `map/`, `routeList/`). Must not import adapters; receive services via React Context.
  - `src/entrypoints`: composition root only. `main-map.tsx` / `main-routeList.tsx` load CSS, analytics and the service worker (map page only), then dynamically import `mapApp.tsx` / `routeListApp.tsx` after the first contentful paint (`afterFirstPaint.ts`). Those build dependencies and mount via `mountApp.tsx` (`hydrateRoot` on prerendered HTML, `createRoot` on the dev server). `prerender.tsx` renders pages at build time.
  - `src/styles`: Tailwind input and `icons.css` (inlined into each HTML head at build time).
  - Dependencies point inward only; `npm run lint` enforces this with eslint-plugin-boundaries.
- Do not move browser APIs (`document`, `window`, DOM, MapLibre instances) into domain or application modules.
- Keep ViewModel logic framework-agnostic and testable without DOM; React subscribes via `useViewModelState` (useSyncExternalStore).
- Services needed by the map page UI are declared as `MapPageServices` in `src/presentation/map/mapPageServices.tsx` and implemented in `src/entrypoints/mapServices.ts`.
- MapLibre controls are added as empty `ContainerControl`s (adapters) and their content is rendered by React portals. Keep control order: hamburger (before `load`), then layers, then route filter (after `load`).
- Do not import `maplibre-gl` from presentation; use the `MapHandle` abstraction. MapLibre is loaded by a dynamic import of `adapters/map/mapFactory` when the map is created; keep it out of the entry chunks.
- Pages are prerendered at build time (SSG) and hydrated. Components must not read `window`, `document` or cookies during render; do it in effects.
- Icons are inline SVGs from Font Awesome Free 7.3.1 (`src/presentation/common/Icon.tsx`). Register any new icon in `ICONS`; unregistered icons render as an empty `<i>` with a console warning.

## 3. Coding Guidelines
- Use small, focused functions and keep side effects localized.
- Prefer explicit dependency injection over hidden imports for new modules.
- Maintain current naming and file layout conventions unless migration docs require a rename.
- Avoid broad refactors unrelated to the user request.
- Keep comments short and only where logic is non-obvious.

## 4. UI and Accessibility
- Keep existing UI behavior and selectors (DOM IDs/classes, cookie keys, share URL params) unless intentionally migrating with tests updated.
- Prefer JSX over `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
- Ensure interactive controls remain keyboard accessible.
- Preserve Japanese user-facing content and route metadata fidelity.

## 5. Testing Policy
- For logic changes, add or update `vitest` tests near the affected module. Component tests use React Testing Library (`*.test.tsx` with `// @vitest-environment jsdom`).
- For behavior touching map/list user flows, consider relevant Playwright coverage.
- Use these commands:
  - `npm run test`
  - `npm run test:e2e`
  - Also run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint`.
- On Windows, run Vitest from a working directory that starts with an uppercase drive letter (`C:\`). With a lowercase `c:\` (e.g. Git Bash), Vitest loads modules twice and every test fails.
- Tailwind CSS is generated by `@tailwindcss/vite` during `npm run dev` / `npm run build`.

## 6. Data and Network Safety
- Do not alter external data source URLs or PMTiles integration behavior without explicit request.
- Handle network failures defensively in adapter code paths.
- Keep persistence compatibility for existing cookie keys and share URL parameters.

## 7. Change Delivery Expectations
- Keep diffs minimal and scoped to the task.
- When fixing bugs, include a regression test whenever practical.
- Document important trade-offs in the PR/commit message or related docs if behavior changes are unavoidable.

## 8. Priority References
- `README.md`
- `docs/searoute-spec.md`

If guidance conflicts, follow explicit user instructions first, then repository docs, then this file.
